svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two. Cut 100 x 100 mm from 6 mm aluminium plate; deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark a centre cross. Measure sideways from the vertical centre line

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and up or down from the horizontal one.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mast U-bolt holes: four 9 mm holes, 24 mm each side of centre,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 30 mm above and 30 mm below centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Standoff U-bolt holes: four 9 mm holes, 35 mm each side of centre,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 20.9 mm above and 20.9 mm below centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check the U-bolts you bought: their leg spacing sets these holes

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (M8 U-bolts for 40 mm tube and for 33.7 mm pipe).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the plate stands upright between the mast and the standoff;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the mast touches one face, the standoff the other. Two U-bolts

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: wrap the mast, two wrap the standoff, nyloc nuts on the far face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: all eight holes line up with the U-bolt legs by hand.
